brief.headline: Blackstone's Data Center REIT Makes First Investment With $5B AWS Deal
bullets: Infrastructure & Energy: Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust will acquire a 75% stake in 13 powered shells spread across two AWS data center campuses.

M&A & Buyouts: Long-term investors reaffirm commitment to supporting the combined company's growth, product innovation and customer service MENLO PARK, Calif. and BOSTON, Nov. 16, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Accel-KKR and RS2 Healthcare Partners (formerly Riverside Partners), investors in Loftware.

Family Offices & Wealth: BlackRock is seeking approval for an exchange-traded interval fund, or ETIF, that would allow investors to trade shares throughout the day while giving managers greater latitude to hold private assets.

M&A & Buyouts: Brookfield Asset Management and KKR have emerged as the leading bidders to acquire a controlling stake in Gulf eyewear retailer Eyewa, in a potential transaction valuing the business at approximately $700m, according to a report by the Financial Times.

brief.marketRead: Bottom line: calm volatility and open credit markets are a supportive backdrop for dealmaking, fundraising and exits.
